title: The Prismatic Creature Battler
genre: Team-Building Prismatic Auto-Battler & Living Collectible Card Game

jam_rules.theme: Refractive Resonance — Every creature is a living collectible, every team is a strategic composition, and every battle is a personalized spectacle.
constraints: 8 deliberately designed creatures across 8 Origins and 8 Instincts
3 distinct team archetypes (Storm-Crystal-Void Voltbrand Chain, Flame-Astral-Eclipse Solar Crucible, Tide-Verdant-Crystal Abyssal Bloom)
6v6 compact positional battlefield (3 Frontline + 3 Backline per side) with reserve bench and Captain slot
Refractive Resonance cross-creature reaction chains feeding the shared Prism Gauge for Convergence events
3 material-driven cosmetic foil treatments (Prismatic Spectrum, Phantom Foil, Relic Foil) separated strictly from competitive power

audience: Strategy and collectible card players who want tactical synergy engineering and living holographic creature spectacle without pay-to-win distortion.
player_fantasy: Collect living prismatic creatures in museum-grade interactive foil cards, engineer 6-unit formations whose Origins and Instincts chain together through Refractive Resonance, and watch those cards materialize onto a dimensional Prismatic Sanctuary arena to unleash team-wide Convergence spectacles.
creative_thesis: Every creature is a living collectible with multi-layer parallax and masked diffraction foil; every team is a causal Refractive Resonance circuit where marks, wards, and phase strikes chain across units; and every battle materializes cards onto a dimensional 3D-perspective sanctuary where player-engineered synergies ignite the Prism Gauge.
design_pillars: Living Collectible Cards: Multi-layered creature portraits with masked Prismatic Spectrum, Phantom Foil, and Relic Foil shaders that never alter competitive stats.
Refractive Resonance Chains: Creatures do not fire isolated skills; Storm Voltbrand marks trigger Crystal Refractive Wards and open Void Phase Rend backline assassinations.
Hybrid Dimensional Materialization: Cards live as tactile holographic collectibles in Collection & Prep, then materialize onto a tilted dimensional arena in Battle.
Legible Causal Spectacle: Every mark, refraction beam, shield facet, phase rift, and Prism Gauge Convergence event is visually and log-traceably tied to player positioning.
core_loop: PREPARE: Recruit from the 8-creature standardized pool, assign Captain + 3 Frontline / 3 Backline slots, select Tactical Directive, and customize cosmetic Foil Variant in the Collection Exhibition.
BATTLE: Cards materialize onto the dimensional arena; deterministic tick simulation resolves targeting, Origin/Instinct triggers, Refractive Resonance chains, and Prism Gauge Convergence events.
ADAPT: Inspect the causal Resonance Combat Log and synergy breakdown, earn Prismatic Shards & Collector Editions, counter the next opponent archetype, and advance through the 3-Round Gauntlet.

controls.mouse_move: Tilt living holographic cards in 3D parallax and shift spectral diffraction angle
controls.left_click: Select creature card, assign Frontline/Backline hex slot, designate Captain, toggle Foil Edition, or trigger Battle
controls.number_keys_1_8: Quick-inspect roster creatures 1-8 in Collection Exhibition or recruit to formation
controls.f_key: Cycle cosmetic foil edition (Prismatic Spectrum / Phantom Foil / Relic Foil / Standard)
controls.r_key: Reset match or load archetype preset (1: Storm-Crystal-Void Chain, 2: Flame-Astral Crucible, 3: Tide-Verdant Sanctuary)

success_criteria: Players can deliberately construct and observe Refractive Resonance chains (e.g., Tempest Wyrm Voltbrand -> Prismhart Refractive Ward -> Riftstalker Phase Rend).
Positioning (Frontline vs Backline, adjacency to Prismhart, flank alignment for Riftstalker) and Tactical Directives demonstrably flip battle outcomes against higher raw-stat lineups.
Holographic cards render with interactive masked diffraction (Prismatic Spectrum, Phantom Foil, Relic Foil) and breathing parallax without obscuring names, stats, or combat telemetry.
Foil variants, serialized collector numbers, and alternate portraits are verified to have zero impact on deterministic combat resolution.
non_goals: Hundreds of filler cards or gacha pack monetization
Pay-to-win stat boosts on rare foils
Opaque black-box RNG combat without causal combat log telemetry
